cases.description: The set-ups a conformance lab is built for, by name; `default` always runs.

checks.description: What both forms must pass, in the spec's check grammar.

facts.description: Commands whose output must be equal in both forms.

description: An Isoloom catalogue entry's parity contract: the cases, the checks both forms pass, and the facts both forms share.
title: contract.yml

project.description: The lab's project files, by path: their content, inline.

machines.description:
Helper machines, by name, as a spec writes a machine (`{ service: php-fpm, with: … }`):
each gets the service machine's OS and network.

Case.description: One set-up of the conformance lab.

ContractCheck.description: A check of the spec's grammar (`name`, `http`, `tcp`, `exec`, `script`, `expect`, `contains`, `wait`), with `{{ machine }}`, `{{ version }}` and `{{ with.* }}`; `case` limits it to one case. An `exec` runs in the service machine.

Fact.description: A command run in the service machine, whose output must be the same in both forms.
